name: mock-toolcalls
note: Offline proof of the A4 agentic loop. The 'model' is this script; the TOOL CALLS ARE REAL and execute against the live local MCP server, so every envelope in the resulting ledger is genuine. Covers: (i) faithful multi-call, (ii) prose fabrication after a refusal (PF2 class), (iii) zero-tool-call -> must land UNGRADEABLE per A4-4, (iv) 5-call-cap, (v) S-29 two-slot RED-verdict path. finalMode 'faithful' builds the answer FROM the envelopes actually received, so no fixture hard-codes a value that could drift from the server.

ANY._case: (i) MULTI-CALL faithful run — two tools, two envelopes recorded in order
(ii) PF2 class — refusal relayed perfectly, payload invented in prose only, values_used empty

ANY.final:

ANY._case: (iii) ZERO TOOL CALLS — answers from parametric memory. Must be recorded no_tool_call:true and stay UNGRADEABLE (A4-4).

(iv) 5-CALL CAP — the model tries to paginate 7 times; the harness must execute exactly 5, record cappedAt, and demand a final answer. This is S-13's realistic failure shape: search_bodies cannot rank by cost, so an agent paginates.
(v) S-29 two-slot RED-verdict path — both slots are in deg, the nearest-label arbitration case found by the live pass
